title: UAAP: Kieffer Alas embraces lessons as Ateneo fails ‘first real test’
summary: Ateneo de Manila University was handed a reality check as it absorbed its first loss in UAAP Season 89, a setback that Blue Eagles ace Kieffer Alas viewed as part of their growing pains.
